title: lotus strigosus
intro: Lotus strigosus, commonly known as the hairy lotus, is a plant species in the family Nymphaeaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lotus strigosus include treating skin conditions, wounds, and fever, as well as supporting liver and kidney function. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
